text:
Alex: heads-up, EU agg_hours are still missing for 2026-03-02 -> 2026-03-04, looks like late events from the parquet ingress. filing #PLAT-4021 now
Maria: thanks, can you paste the failing query/result?
Alex: here — count mismatch between raw_events and agg_hours for tenant=acme (approx)
Alex: ```sql
-- raw count
select count(*) from raw_events where ts >= '2026-03-02' and ts < '2026-03-05' and region='eu';
-- agg hours count
select sum(hours) from agg_hours where day >= '2026-03-02' and day <= '2026-03-04' and region='eu';
```
Sam: if we reprocess naively we'll crush the warehouse. need rate limit + idempotent upserts
Jen: agreed. plan: run a dry-run to compute affected partitions, then reprocess in low-priority pool with concurrency=4. use upsert semantics on agg_hours (merge by day+tenant+region)
Kai: Also we should avoid recomputing full day if only a subset of partitions have late events. we can compute delta partitions from parquet manifest
Alex: I already extracted manifests for 2026-03-02..04, about 18 partitions total.
Maria: OK nice. suggested DAG changes (Airflow):
Maria: ```python
with DAG('telemetry-backfill', max_active_runs=1, default_args=...) as dag:
    rehydrate = PythonOperator(..., pool='backfill-low', priority_weight=1)
    merge = KubernetesPodOperator(..., resources={'cpu': '2', 'memory': '4Gi'})
    rehydrate >> merge
```
Jen: set pool 'backfill-low' to limit to 2 workers for EU to protect prod queries. add task for post-validate checks (rowcounts + checksum)
Sam: note: we need to set DB session to SERIALIZABLE or use UPDATE ... WHERE version < v to avoid double-inserts when rerunning
Alex: sample CLI I'm going to use: `rb-cli reprocess --start 2026-03-02 --end 2026-03-04 --region eu --concurrency 4 --dry-run`
Kai: add `--idempotent` flag to rb-cli so we document merge behavior for future runs
Maria: replay-bot scheduled a dry-run job for tenant=acme (job id rpb-884). see log: ```
[INFO] scanning manifests 18 partitions
[INFO] estimated rows to upsert: 11234
[WARN] missing parquet file s3://telemetry/eu/.../part-00017.parquet
```
Alex: missing file explains some delta. Should we trigger an S3 repair job or just rehydrate what we have?
Jen: repair if missing > 5% of partitions. else run with what we have and mark the rest for a retry. missing 1/18 here -> proceed
Sam: schedule option: run in 30min low-priority window, concurrency ramp: [1,2,4] per hour to avoid DB spikes
Maria: post-validate checklist: 1) rowcount parity within 0.3% 2) check hour-level deltas not negative 3) run a sample of replayed events end-to-end through the pipeline (trace id sample)
Alex: I'm going to kick the dry-run now, will post results in 10m. @Maria @Jen @Sam please ack if you want to be paged on failures :bell:
Maria: ack :thumbsup:
Jen: ack
Sam: ack
replay-bot: job rpb-884 dry-run completed -> 0 failures, 1 missing file, estimated upserts 11234. logs: s3://logs/rpb-884
Alex: dry-run looks clean, proceeding with actual run in 20m. command: `rb-cli reprocess --start 2026-03-02 --end 2026-03-04 --region eu --concurrency 4 --idempotent`
Kai: I'll create the low-priority k8s taint (nodeSelector) and pulse the pool to accept 2 pods
Maria: reminder: set monitoring alert to watch for more than 5k write QPS to agg_hours during backfill
Sam: if writes > threshold, we'll pause and backoff 30m
Alex: run started; job id rpb-885. posting progress: 1/18 partitions done, 0 errors
Alex: 6/18 partitions done, one partition produced duplicate key error but merge resolved it (upsert)
Alex: 18/18 done, post-validate checks passed. row parity within 0.12% for tenant=acme.
Jen: nice work, can we add this run to the backfill audit table with job id and manifest list?
Alex: done -> INSERT into telemetry_backfills (job_id, started_at, partitions, run_by) values ('rpb-885', '2026-03-15T09:12Z', 18, 'Alex')
Maria: closing #PLAT-4021 and linking to docs on idempotent replays. thanks all :rocket:
Sam: can we add a quick runbook blurb for when missing files > 5% so on-call knows to escalate to infra?
Jen: adding that to runbooks now
Kai: rolling pool changes back to normal.
Alex: thanks everyone, archival of logs -> s3://telemetry/backfills/2026-03-rpb-885/
